en.text: Today will be hot, so why are you carrying around with you a wool sweater?

original: 今日は暖かかったね。

en.text: It was warm today.
Today was warm.
It was warm today, wasn't it?

original: その冬は例年になく暖かかった。

en.text: That winter was unusually mild.

original: 外はとても暖かかった。

en.text: It was very warm out.
It was very warm outside.

original: 梅一輪一輪ほどの暖かさ。

en.text: Plum blossom by plum blossom comes warmth.
